assignmentsStatus: Initial source material mapping; later archived/rebuilt surfaces are identified in workingGeometryChanges and Source_Finishes.

terrace.uv: Long grain along source X; top UV avoids painted joints because boards have actual gaps.

stairs.sourceOverlap: Two source flights share the middle tread within 1 micrometre; preserved as one working pair of boards.

eastCladding.method: Original closed siding profile and straight lower edge continued across house and terrace at -0.43 m. Six original recessed 50 mm plinth battens remain separate below; no facade extension to ground. Deck-height notch and exposed ledge removed.
eastCladding.plinthUV: Individual batten UVs exclude the texture painted joint; physical source gaps only.
eastCladding.uvPhase: u=(sourceZ-0.02)/0.15; v=(sourceY-sourceCenterY)/2.4, continuous over house and terrace.

terraceFascia.scope: Closed fascia boards below terrace only; open terrace above, stair treads and narrow lower plinth retained.

rainChains.mounts: No separate chain-only mount objects in source; full chain meshes removed, two continuous roof gutters retained.
